title: rail-hint
description: Advisory rail-negotiation extension for x402 v2 402 responses. Carried at extensions["rail-hint"] as {info, schema}; this schema validates the info object. (Deprecated alias from draft-railhint-00: extensions.railHint, fields flat.) Non-binding: the accepts array remains the only binding payment terms.

cheapest.description: The `network` value of the offer in `accepts` the server considers lowest total-cost for the payer.

why.description: Rationale a reasoning client can evaluate. SHOULD contain concrete prices, not slogans.

bootstrap.description: Executable onboarding path for the hinted rail. UNTRUSTED INPUT: clients MUST NOT execute blindly.

topup.description: Path from commonly-held assets to the hinted asset. MUST NOT require a specific vendor.

faucets.description: Endpoints offering small starter grants: POST {"address": ...}; MAY require a proof-of-work challenge from GET <faucet>/challenge.

spec.description: Reference to the payment-scheme specification for the hinted rail.
